activity.notes: Uzun Hasan emerged as the dominant ruler of the Aq Qoyunlu in the early 1450s and transformed the confederation into a major imperial power. Modern references vary slightly over the accession year (1452/1453); ATLAS uses c.1453 while preserving the exact death date of 6 January 1478.

sources.title: AQ QOYUNLŪ — Encyclopaedia Iranica
sources.citation_text: Encyclopaedia Iranica describes the Aq Qoyunlu empire reaching its zenith under Uzun Hasan and records his death on 5-6 January 1478.

sources.title: Uzun Həsən (1423-1478) — Türk Dünyası Ansiklopedisi
sources.citation_text: The encyclopedia records Uzun Hasan as ascending the Aq Qoyunlu throne in 1453 and ruling until 1478.
